card.title: The Lost Finale
card.summary: An unrecognized melody draws the Twin-Tone Musician back to an abandoned concert hall. Guqin and Harp each remember half of it. Who owns the missing finale?
card.quote: If both voices are real, who is the silence answering for?

hero-dualtone-01.title: Segment 1 · A Beat Out of Time
hero-dualtone-01.summary: An old terminal receives an anonymous recording with fingerings the Musician has never learned.

d1-intro.speaker: Narration
d1-intro.text: At two in the morning, an old terminal in the abandoned concert hall wakes by itself. A single new file waits on screen: an unsigned performance.

d1-hero.speaker: Twin-Tone Musician
d1-hero.text: This melody sounds like mine, and it doesn't. Guqin remembers the opening; Harp remembers the ending. One beat is missing between them.

d1-choice.prompt: The terminal reports that the original recording is damaged. Listen first, or trace where it came from?
options: Put on the headphones and hear the broken melody

d1-listen.speaker: Twin-Tone Musician
d1-listen.text: There is a breath between the strings. Not a performer taking a breath — someone waiting for another instrument to answer.

d1-trace.speaker: Qiong
d1-trace.text: The signal leads to the old rehearsal room beneath the hall. Its access log says nobody has entered in ten years.

d1-battle.title: The Silent Rehearsal Room
d1-battle.brief: The echoes begin copying your rhythm. Clear the distorted images guarding the door.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Every note lands, and its echo follows half a beat late

skills.name: String Echo
skills.description: A close-range wave slows its target

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: Another form emerges from the old recording

skills.name: False Tuning
skills.description: A sound wave briefly stuns its target

d1-after.speaker: Narration
d1-after.text: As the last echo fades, the terminal plays a new measure. It fills the missing beat, then reveals a name: Beyond the Strings.

d1-reward.title: Recording Fragment
d1-reward.description: You save the restored recording. Its file metadata contains an old rehearsal-room number.

d1-end.title: End of Segment 1
d1-end.text: The Musician stores the recording in the memories of both Guqin and Harp. Neither admits it belongs to them.

hero-dualtone-02.title: Segment 2 · The Blank Score
hero-dualtone-02.summary: A score with its final page torn out lies in the basement rehearsal room, marked in two different hands.

d2-intro.speaker: Narration
d2-intro.text: There are no footprints in the rehearsal-room dust, yet a freshly opened score rests on the stand. Its last page has been cleanly removed.

d2-hero.speaker: Twin-Tone Musician
d2-hero.text: Guqin's fingering is marked on the left, Harp's notation on the right. Two people must have taken turns answering on the same page.

d2-choice.prompt: An old tape is tucked into the score. Restore it first, or follow the marks to find its author?
options: Connect the tape to the terminal
Follow the marks to their performer

d2-record.speaker: Qiong
d2-record.text: Restoration complete. Two people speak on the tape, but every time they mention the finale, the sound is cut away.

d2-follow.speaker: Beyond the Strings
d2-follow.text: Stop looking for that page. It wasn't lost. Someone didn't want it performed.

d2-battle.title: The Sealed Platform
d2-battle.brief: Guardians of the old tape block the way to the archive.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: The notes play backward, and your steps begin to lag

skills.name: Reversed Strings
skills.description: Strings bind and damage their target

d2-after.speaker: Narration
d2-after.text: The archive has no complete score, but it does hold an unsent letter. The finale, it says, should be decided by whoever hears it.

d2-reward.title: The Unsent Letter
d2-reward.description: An old concert-hall address is written on the envelope. The recipient line is blank.

d2-end.title: End of Segment 2
d2-end.text: The Musician understands at last: the missing page is not an answer. It is a choice left to the performer.

hero-dualtone-03.title: Segment 3 · Beyond the Resonance
hero-dualtone-03.summary: Beyond the Strings returns to the hall with a choice: complete the finale or let the silence remain.

d3-intro.speaker: Narration
d3-intro.text: The stage lights come on one by one. Beyond the Strings stands at center stage, holding the missing page.

d3-hero.speaker: Twin-Tone Musician
d3-hero.text: Did you remove the finale because you feared it, or because you didn't want to write an ending for someone else?

d3-choice.prompt: Beyond the Strings places the page on the stand. Complete the finale, or preserve its silence?
options: Finish the melody with both forms

d3-complete.speaker: Twin-Tone Musician
d3-complete.text: Guqin plays the first note. Harp does not follow; it answers with a different voice.

d3-silence.speaker: Beyond the Strings
d3-silence.text: Thank you. A blank is not forgetting. It simply refuses to speak for anyone.

d3-battle.title: Before the Finale
d3-battle.brief: Distorted resonance takes shape as one last guardian. Cross the echoes and hear the melody beneath them.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Sound waves cross as the edge of the stage begins to tremble

skills.name: Sealed Strings
skills.description: A sound field binds and damages

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: The other performer stops copying and finally plays back

skills.name: Final Resonance
skills.description: A powerful resonance stuns on impact

d3-after.speaker: Narration
d3-after.text: The last echo fades. There is no applause, only the fading notes of two instruments. Beyond the Strings hands the page back to you.

d3-choice-end.prompt: How will you preserve the score?
options: Record the finale played by both voices
Keep the blank for someone else to decide

d3-reward-play.title: A Resonant Finale
d3-reward-play.description: You save the complete performance, including every voice that differs.

d3-end-play.title: Story Complete
d3-end-play.text: The Musician returns the last page to the archive. The finale belongs to no single person — it belongs to everyone willing to hear it through.

d3-reward-keep.title: An Unfinished Score
d3-reward-keep.description: You keep the blank page, leaving room for someone else to write.

d3-end-keep.title: Story Complete
d3-end-keep.text: The Musician writes no notes. Another performer will come, and the next voice need not sound like today's.
